what: On a frost layer covering the screen (blurs what is behind by 100px and overlays 60% paper color), two vertical lines of verse form in the center, from blur 10px and transparent over 1s (blur takes 1.3s). After holding 3s, the verse blurs out again over 1s (blur .8s), and the layer lifts .5s later over 2s, so the page behind sharpens like mist clearing. With look: plain there is no verse, and only the layer lifts, right away, .5s later over 2s. This is the transition feel for sub-pages reached from within the site

options.delay: Time (seconds) from when the verse starts to blur until the curtain lifts, default .5
options.look: With plain, the curtain lifts right away without the poetic line
options.[data-fx-part=verse]: Center vertical poem line (the curtain still lifts without it)

use:
First line
Second row

· Subpages: data-fx-frost-veil-loader="look: plain"
note: The element remains after the curtain lifts (pointer-events: none) — it fires fx:open (lifting starts) and fx:done (fully lifted)
